description:
Ever wondered what's really going on inside your everyday machines?
This channel breaks down the inner workings of the technology around you — from washing machines to engines, from refrigerators to turbines, from smartphones to power tools. We take complex engineering and make it simple, visual, and fun to watch.

We also expose common scams, misleading marketing tricks, and overpriced repairs in the tech and appliance industry. Knowing how your machine works means no one can rip you off.

All content on this channel is created with an educational and informational purpose. Where third-party visuals or references appear, they are used in a transformative manner under Fair Use principles!
